description: This file defines a CreditService class responsible for managing credits, including charging credits, checking availability, transferring credits between teams and organizations, and handling low credit balance warnings and limits. It interacts with repositories, billing services, and external modules to perform credit-related operations within a billing system.

classes.name: CreditService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to manage credits, including charging, checking availability, transferring, and handling low balance warnings.

methods.name: chargeCredits
methods.description: Charges credits to a user or team, logs expenses, and handles low credit balance warnings.

methods.name: hasAvailableCredits
methods.description: Checks if a user or team has available credits.

methods.name: getTeamWithAvailableCredits
methods.description: Retrieves a team with available credits for a user.

methods.name: filterMembershipsForCreditCheck
methods.description: Filters memberships to prioritize organization memberships for credit checks.

methods.name: _getTeamWithAvailableCredits
methods.description: Internal method to determine a team with available credits, considering memberships and limits.

methods.name: getUserOrTeamToCharge
methods.description: Determines whether to charge a user or team based on available credits.

methods.name: _getUserOrTeamToCharge
methods.description: Internal logic to select a user or team to charge credits.

methods.name: _createExpenseLog
methods.description: Creates a log entry for a credit expense.

methods.name: _handleLowCreditBalance
methods.description: Handles low credit balance scenarios, sets limits, and warnings.

methods.name: _handleLowCreditBalanceResult
methods.description: Sends emails and cancels scheduled messages based on low credit balance results.

methods.name: handleLowCreditBalance
methods.description: Public method to handle low credit balance with transaction support.

methods.name: getMonthlyCredits
methods.description: Calculates monthly credits for a team based on subscription and membership.

methods.name: calculateCreditsFromPrice
methods.description: Converts a price to credits with markup.

methods.name: getAllCredits
methods.description: Retrieves total credits for a user or team.

methods.name: _getAllCredits
methods.description: Internal method to get credits for user or team.

methods.name: getAllCreditsForTeam
methods.description: Retrieves all credits for a specific team.

methods.name: _getAllCreditsForTeam
methods.description: Internal method to compute credits and usage for a team.

methods.name: moveCreditsFromTeamToOrg
methods.description: Transfers credits from a team to an organization.

methods.name: _getUserIdsWithoutCredits
methods.description: Finds user IDs within a team that have no available credits.
